name: ME 2120
title: Applied Mechanics II
description: (Also offered as CE 2120.) Fundamentals of dynamics using vector methods. Rectilinear and curvilinear motion, translation, rotation, plane motion; work, energy, and power; impulse and momentum.
requirement_description: CE 2110; MATH 2110Q or MATH 2130Q. May not be taken for credit after PHYS 3101.
